read.thesis: Q2 CY26 prelim miss: Infrastructure down 7% and Software up 5% on mainframe-cycle shortfall and deal slippage, though Distributed Infrastructure rose 37% with a ~$500M backlog; GAAP EPS $2.27 down 2%.

triggers.label: Mainframe shortfall vs April expectations
triggers.quote: What played out was worse than our expectations, driven by a shortfall in our Z performance and the associated software stack

triggers.label: Client capex shifted to servers, storage, memory
triggers.quote: clients shift their quarterly capex spend toward servers, storage, and memory purchases to secure supply-constrained infrastructure ahead of expected price increases

triggers.label: Distributed Infrastructure up 37%, backlog ~$500M
triggers.quote: Distributed Infrastructure had its best performance in reported history, up 37 percent

triggers.label: Full-year outlook deferred to July 22 call
triggers.quote: We will hold our regularly scheduled conference call with you all on July 22, 2026, at 5PM ET to go into deeper detail and discuss our full-year expectations.

guidance.value: decline low-single digits (prior expectation, not reiterated)
guidance.quote: we expected Infrastructure revenue to decline low-single digits for the year, beginning this quarter

prior_guidance_check.metric: Infrastructure revenue decline low-single digits for the year
prior_guidance_check.quote: What played out was worse than our expectations, driven by a shortfall in our Z performance

red_flags.label: Large deals failed to close on expected timelines
red_flags.quote: numerous large deals failed to close on the timelines we expected, driving the majority of our shortfall
